responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduler model for the embedded PowerPC 403 and 405 cores. It describes the available issue, branch, integer, and optional floating-point units and assigns latencies/reservations to RS/6000 machine-description instruction classes such as loads, stores, compares, multiply/divide, CR and jump-register operations, so GCC’s instruction scheduler can order generated RTL appropriately for these in-order 40x-family processors.
